# Stellar Roots Media

> Stellar Roots Media is an Austin, Texas creative and performance marketing agency. We produce premium video creative and run strategic Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertising that generates qualified leads for established, high-ticket service businesses. Positioning: "Made to stand out. Built to perform." We function as an outsourced creative and advertising department — clients get distinctive creative plus managed performance campaigns without building an in-house team.

## Key facts
- **Type:** Creative + performance marketing agency (video production + Meta advertising)
- **Location:** Austin, Texas — serves clients locally and nationwide
- **Ideal clients:** Established, high-ticket service businesses
- **Core offering:** Premium video creative + strategically managed Meta ad campaigns for lead generation
- **System:** Create → Launch → Optimize (capture & produce creative, launch Meta campaigns, optimize continuously)
- **Rating:** 5.0 average on Google

## Engagement
Stellar Roots Media works on simple monthly retainers, delivered as an outsourced creative and advertising department. Scope ranges from managed Meta advertising with performance creative up to a full engine that adds quarterly video capture, organic content, and search/authority work. Specific packages and pricing are shared on a discovery (strategy) call; ad spend is separate and paid directly to Meta.

## Documented results
- $2.84 average cost per lead on a live Meta campaign (lifetime).
- 103.4% year-over-year revenue increase for a content + advertising client.
- +2,776% organic impressions; +69.7% follower growth (Instagram).

## Clients
Brands Stellar Roots Media has worked with include Buc-ee's, Fairmont, Harlem Globetrotters, Icelandic Glacial, Networking Austin, Apex Pursuit, Archery Country, Turtlebox, and Premier Mattress.
